## Result: no Page Object Model layer exists in this repository

Checked on 2026-08-30 while refactoring the weight-notes UI specs.

Evidence:
- No file under `src/` or `tests/` imports `@playwright/test`.
- No file defines a Playwright page-object class (no `page: Page` constructor
  property, no `frameLocator(...)`, no locator properties).
- The repository's own tests are vitest + React Testing Library component tests,
  which mount components directly and expose no reusable browser-driving layer.

Path alias available for future use: `@/*` -> `./src/*` (tsconfig.json).
